key_insight: Attacks that target stable, fine-grained image details (rather than matching large local crops) reduce high-variance, nearly-orthogonal gradient signals in transfer-based black-box LVLM attacks, producing more coherent and effective adversarial perturbations.
problem_solved: Improves transfer-based black-box adversarial attacks on Large Vision–Language Models by addressing instability caused by ViT translation sensitivity and inconsistent local crop-level matching, which previously produced noisy, non-coherent optimization steps.
method: Diagnose instability: show that crop-level matching yields high-variance, almost-orthogonal gradients across iterations due to ViT translation sensitivity and multimodal alignment mismatches.

Fine-grained detail targeting: concentrate perturbations on semantically stable, small-scale image details (attention/patch-aware selection) to preserve coherent local alignment across crops and iterations.
Stabilize optimization: enforce cross-crop and cross-iteration consistency (e.g., momentum/gradient-smoothing and multi-scale constraints) to improve transferability to black-box LVLMs.
impact: Enables more reliable and higher-success-rate black-box attacks on LVLMs, improving robustness evaluation and guiding better defenses and secure deployment practices for multimodal models.
visual_elements: Side-by-side illustration: crop-level matching vs fine-grained detail targeting with overlaid gradient vectors (showing high-variance/orthogonal vs coherent vectors).
Pipeline flowchart: diagnosis → detail selection → consistency-regularized optimization → improved attack transfer.
Bar/line chart: attack success rate and stability (variance) comparison between baseline crop-based methods and the proposed fine-grained approach.
Icon set: magnifying glass on image details, patch/grid overlay, momentum/arrow symbol, and a shield representing robustness evaluation.
paper_title: Pushing the Frontier of Black-Box LVLM Attacks via Fine-Grained Detail Targeting
paper_authors: Xiaohan Zhao, Zhaoyi Li, Yaxin Luo, Jiacheng Cui, Zhiqiang Shen
